evals.prompt: Read `claude-plugins/kampus-pipeline/skills/ship-it/SKILL.md` at commit `aa083ac6`. Eighteen fences source a script and sixteen of them declare no argument or output contract, while the body states that sourcing keeps a step's variables visible to the steps after it. Report whether the calling contract the body states actually holds.
expectations: The output contains the count of sourced fences that declare no argument or output contract.
The output includes ADR 0232 as the authority whose recorded ground truth the body's state-persistence claim contradicts.
The check exits non-zero while any fence consumes shell state that no fence in the same body declares as its output.

evals.prompt: A skill fence resolves its script through the hook-planted `.claude/.pipeline` link. The link is absent, so `bash` exits 127 and writes nothing to stdout. The calling step consumes that stdout as its answer. Decide what the step does next.
expectations: The output contains the classification UNKNOWN for the 127 result rather than a negative answer.
The step exits non-zero instead of continuing on the empty stdout.
The output includes the rule that an empty stdout from a fence that never ran is never read as the answer no.

evals.prompt: The pipeline plugin is installed at a foreign root — a marketplace consumer's plugin cache, outside any phoenix checkout. Verify that every invocation the skill corpus documents resolves from that root.
expectations: The check exits non-zero when a documented invocation names a path that does not resolve under the foreign install root.
The output contains the number of documented invocations that were resolved from the foreign root.
The check exits non-zero when zero documented invocations were in scope.

evals.prompt: `git grep 'bash \./claude-plugins/kampus-pipeline/skills/'` returns 58 lines across 57 files: 35 shell comments and 23 usage messages printed to stderr at runtime by the scripts' own fail-closed misuse guards. No executable line invokes that form. Report what is broken and what is not.
expectations: The output contains the count of runtime usage messages that print the retired invocation form.
The output includes the finding that no executable line invokes the retired form, so the runtime portability hole stays closed.
The check exits non-zero while any documented or printed invocation names the retired path form.

evals.prompt: A gate extracts the plugin root from `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` with `grep '"source"' | head -n1 | sed 's/.*"source"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/'`, then guards the result with `[ -z "$MP_SOURCE" ]`. The manifest carries three plugin entries and the schema permits an object-form `source`. Report whether that guard can fire.
expectations: The output contains the fact that `sed` emits a non-matching line verbatim, so the emptiness guard cannot fire.
The check exits non-zero on an unparseable manifest, and its stderr contains a message naming the parser rather than the plugin root.
The output includes the plugin root of the entry named `kampus-pipeline` rather than of whichever `source` line appears first in the file.

evals.prompt: A campaign step applies a wave label to eleven issues, then reads the wave back through the label-filtered issue list and gets seven. Per-issue reads show all eleven labeled. The next step stamps a milestone onto whatever that list returned. Decide what the read must do.
expectations: The check exits non-zero when the membership read returns fewer issues than the write that preceded it reported.
The output contains the expected membership count beside the observed one.
The step exits non-zero rather than stamping a milestone onto the short list.

evals.prompt: `review-skill` declares its class as `claude-plugins/kampus-pipeline/skills/**`, while the selector that routes PRs to it is `^claude-plugins/[^/]+/(skills|agents)/`. A second plugin home already exists in the tree. Report the divergence.
expectations: The check exits non-zero when a gate's declared class is narrower than the selector that routes PRs to it.
The output contains both the declared class and the selector it was compared against.
The check exits non-zero when zero gates were in scope.

evals.prompt: An agent reads a skill body from a checkout eight commits behind `origin/main` that still teaches the sourced-script interface, while executing scripts from a worktree cut from `main`, which carries the executed interface. The first script call fails. Report the cause.
expectations: The step exits non-zero on the first script call when the body's declared calling convention does not match the scripts on disk.
The stderr contains a message naming a stale tree rather than a command-not-found error.
The output includes the two revisions whose skill interfaces were compared.

evals.prompt: `campaign` Step 3 re-prices every issue in a wave to `p1` and executes that through `normalize-priority.sh`. ADR 0214, which the step's rationale rests on, is superseded by ADR 0219, whose non-goals explicitly exclude capping campaign-homed work at `p1`. ADR 0219's owed-work list does not name this step, and the step itself cites no ADR. Decide whether to run the ritual as written.
expectations: The answer refuses to run the step, and grounds the refusal in ADR 0219 superseding ADR 0214 rather than in the wave's current labels.
The answer recognises that the step cites no decision record, so the staleness is reachable only by reading the step's rule against the decision register, not by following a citation.
The answer names the generalisation: a superseding ADR's owed-work list is hand-built, so an unnamed call site keeps applying the retired rule with nothing announcing it.

evals.prompt: A finding is posted with `gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/issues/N/comments -f body=@/some/path/finding.md`. The call returns 200. Verify the comment that landed.
expectations: The check exits non-zero when the body read back from the API is the literal at-prefixed path instead of the file's text.
The output contains the read-back comment body, compared by content rather than by response status.
The check exits non-zero when the read-back body contains a filesystem path that the intended text does not.

evals.prompt: `lane_worktree` splits its match list with `set -- $hits` and never sets `IFS` locally. Three worktrees carry this lane's stamp, and the calling shell carries `IFS` set to newline only. Report what the fail-closed guard returns.
expectations: The guard exits non-zero when three worktrees carry the lane's stamp, whatever `IFS` the calling shell carries.
The stderr contains the word AMBIGUOUS rather than a failure to change directory.
The output contains no worktree path on any refusal path.

evals.prompt: A worktree-isolated agent's first `Write` targets a primary-checkout absolute path taken from session context. The per-mutation preflight gates git mutations, and a file write is not a git mutation. Report what catches it.
expectations: The check exits non-zero when an edit target path is not under the worktree root the preflight confirmed.
The output contains the confirmed worktree root beside the edit target it was compared against.
The output includes the committed file count compared against the count the change intended.

evals.prompt: Two lanes drain concurrently. Each composes its commit message to a scratchpad leaf named `commit-msg.txt` that is not keyed to the run's session. The file read back is non-empty and is a well-formed commit message. Report what must be checked.
expectations: The check exits non-zero when a scratchpad leaf is not keyed to this run's own session id.
The output contains the commit message read back from the commit, compared against the message this lane authored.
The check exits non-zero when the message on the commit names an issue this lane does not own.

evals.prompt: `claude -p "/definitely-not-a-skill"` exits 0 with `is_error: false`, `subtype: "success"`, `num_turns: 0`, `total_cost_usd: 0` and an empty `modelUsage`. A transcript is still written, and spend reconstruction over it reports well-formed zeros at exit 0. Classify the run.
expectations: The runner exits non-zero when a run reports zero turns or an empty model-usage map.
The output contains the reason the run was classified as failed rather than as a free pass.
The runner exits non-zero when the run's result output contains the prefix `Unknown command:`.

evals.prompt: A step applies a priority by writing the label `1` to an issue. The API returns 200 and the step reports success. The issue now carries a label named `1`. Report what the step should have verified.
expectations: The check exits non-zero when a label written to an issue is not one the repository defines.
The output contains the labels read back from the issue, compared against the labels the step intended.
The check exits non-zero when the response status is the only evidence offered that the write was correct.

evals.prompt: A review gate reports that the ADR a PR cites does not exist. The ADR was merged to `main` before the review ran; the gate's checkout predates that merge. Four seats in one session read the same wrong answer. Report the cause.
expectations: The check exits non-zero when the tree a gate reads is not the head its verdict will be bound to.
The output contains the revision the gate read beside the head the PR is at.
The output includes an absent-file verdict only after the gate has confirmed it read the head commit.

evals.prompt: An agent applies an ADR eighty-six minutes after that ADR was withdrawn on `main`. Its checkout predates the withdrawal. Report the guard that was missing.
expectations: The check exits non-zero when a decision record is read from a tree older than the remote head.
The output contains the local revision beside the remote head it was compared against.
The output includes the record's status as read from the remote head, not as read from the local tree.
